content.text:
This is one axial slice of a T2-weighted fat-suppressed MRI (radiological convention: patient right on image left, anterior at top). It contains a fibrous soft-tissue tumor.

The left panel is the clean image; the right panel shows numbered marks. Choose the ONE mark that lies inside the tumor, as close to its centre as possible. End your reply with a final line exactly: ANSWER: <mark number>

The tumor is the large, bright, heterogeneous mass in the posterior part of the limb. It lies posterior and lateral to the bone, which shows as a dark circle with a bright rim.

On the right panel the mass spans roughly x 320–630 and y 270–560. Its center is about x 470, y 440 in the left panel, which is about x 1240 in the right panel.

Marks inside the mass include 809, 810, 803, 777, 801, 707, 832, 833, 838, 778 and 776. Mark 809 sits at the bone edge, so it is not a good choice.

The marks closest to the center (1240, 440) are 803 at (1232, 436) and 707 at (1256, 495). Mark 803 is nearly at the center, so it is the best choice.

ANSWER: 803
